spotifyPrivate.defaultDescription: Use the Spotify app configured for Hiciarz.
spotifyPrivate.ownDescription: Use your own app from the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
spotifyPrivate.defaultAccessDescription: If Spotify denies access, ask the person managing Hiciarz to add your account, or choose your own connection.
spotifyPrivate.noSecret: Only the Client ID is needed. Hiciarz does not use a Client Secret — do not paste it here.
spotifyPrivate.keepSavedConnection: You have a saved connection. Leave the field empty to keep it, or enter a new Client ID to change it.
spotifyPrivate.incomingConfiguration: A configuration was received from a link or QR code. Save the connection to use it, or enter a different Client ID.
spotifyPrivate.howToConfigure: How to create your own connection
spotifyPrivate.createApp: Create or open a Spotify app
spotifyPrivate.selectWebApi: select Web API when creating the app.
spotifyPrivate.redirectInstruction: In your app settings, add this address to Redirect URIs and save the changes.
spotifyPrivate.accountInstruction: In Users Management, add the email address of the Spotify account you will sign in with.
spotifyPrivate.clientIdInstruction: Find it in your app settings. Paste it into the “New Client ID” field and save the connection in Hiciarz.
spotifyPrivate.enterClientId: Enter the Client ID from your Spotify app settings.
